reader.requirement: At --std 85 argument-1 of FUNCTION ACOS must be a class-numeric argument, which A.2.2 type (1) defines as an arithmetic expression (a numeric elementary item, a numeric literal, the figurative ZERO, a nested numeric or integer function, or any combination with operators per VI.6.2.1); the compiler must accept every such form and evaluate it, and may refuse any argument that is not one (alphanumeric, alphabetic, numeric-edited, group, nonnumeric figurative or literal, alphanumeric function). The witness covers item, literal and expression only.
